description: Continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) for CSL time-bounded reachability P(F<=t goal), by uniformisation + Fox-Glynn Poisson truncation. A new MODEL CLASS for IMPaCT. Papers (verified): Baier, Haverkort, Hermanns, Katoen, 'Model-Checking Algorithms for CTMCs', IEEE TSE 29(6) 2003 (DOI 10.1109/TSE.2003.1205180); Fox & Glynn, 'Computing Poisson Probabilities', CACM 31(4) 1988 (DOI 10.1145/42404.42409). Interval-CTMC (uncertain rates) extension: Katoen-Klink-Leucker-Wolf, CAV 2007.

measured.note: Live 2026-07-01. IMPaCT CSL == Storm CSL (storm --prism ctmc_demo.sm -pc --prop 'P=?[F<=t "goal"]') == analytic, to 10 digits.
